p0.resolution: Corrected latest observed tagged release to v0.9.5 while preserving pinned source commit.
Introduced canonical `custom/main` pinned to baseline; all phase branches derive from it.
Bootstrap imports the full control plane into `repo/docs/project/` and versions it.

p0.finding: Semantic rather than exact file ownership
p0.resolution: Added exact per-ticket allowed/forbidden paths plus Implementation Map.
Captures/Notes use Trash/Soft Delete; Purge is explicit and separately confirmed.
Migration requires verified SQLite online backup + integrity check before write migration.
Dictionary/custom-word correction is frozen inside deterministic `normalized_stt`; snapshot hash/version recorded.
Frozen single-pass, left-to-right, longest-match-first, non-recursive matcher.
GUI generates explicit absolute `--data-dir`; companions never guess DB location.
Added `app_meta` schema/query contract versions and fail-closed connector startup.
Added fixed Tauri command names/boundaries and Integrator-only registration.

p0.finding: Hosted CI cannot prove Windows native behavior
p0.resolution: Interactive Windows evidence is required for mic/hotkey/clipboard/window gates.
Added frozen state machines, Rust enums and DB CHECK constraint requirement.
Added Agent Safety Policy prohibiting force/reset/clean/direct integration pushes and bounding retries.

p1.finding: No record of exact text actually delivered
p1.resolution: Added append-only `delivery_events` with immutable source reference, text hash, destination and outcome.
Added OpenAPI 3.1 contract plus shared machine-readable Query DTO schema.
Defined generation, rotation, current-user storage/ACL, no query-string token and no secret logging.
Added machine-readable MCP tool contract with exact JSON Schema inputs and shared DTO outputs.
Added Phase-5 Dependency Lock Policy and explicit `DEP-510` Integrator ticket.
Added Shortcut Contract with stable IDs, conflict behavior and explicit routing.

p1.finding: UI placement left to Integrator discretion
p1.resolution: Added UI Information Architecture for History, Dictionary, Snippets, Profiles, Scratchpad and Local Integrations.
Pure-STT median end-to-paste regression hard budget set to ≤10% vs G0 baseline.
`source_window` is opt-in/disabled by default and excluded from external DTOs by default.

p1.finding: Private transcript/prompt logging risk before release
p1.resolution: Logging privacy policy starts in Phase 0, not only release review.
Frozen repository-managed transactional FTS updates plus explicit full rebuild command/test.

p1.finding: Mutable note current-version pointer can drift
p1.resolution: Removed current-version pointer contract; highest monotonic `version_no` is canonical current version.

p1.finding: Duplicate capture transcription state can drift
p1.resolution: Capture transcription state is derived from attempts rather than duplicated mutable state.

p1.finding: Backup scope could expand MVP unexpectedly
p1.resolution: MVP backup obligation is safe migration/upgrade backup+restore verification, not a general consumer backup feature.
One implementation + two focused fix cycles, then E2 escalation; attempt/context usage is observable.

p2.resolution: Frontmatter uses one `baseline_id`; exact baseline details live in `BASELINE_LOCK.json`.
Execution metadata moved to JSON control plane while Markdown retains rationale.
`render_execution_status.py` generates status from catalog + per-ticket RUN_STATE frontmatter.

p2.finding: Reference audio export is not portable
p2.resolution: Default remains `reference` to avoid duplicate storage; `copy` is documented for portable vaults.
Optional maintenance automation; explicit BASELINE-REFRESH procedure is sufficient for MVP.
MVP threat model relies on Windows account/full-disk encryption; revisit only if threat model changes.
Excluded until real migration demand justifies format-specific importer complexity.
